# Connected Notes

A useful garden is a network rather than a folder of isolated pages.

The [[notes/components|component gallery]] defines the visual vocabulary. The
[[notes/callouts|callout conservatory]] tests semantic surfaces, while the
[[projects/glasshouse|glasshouse project]] applies those ideas to a project.

This page deliberately disables its table of contents so themes cover both
article layouts.
